headline: HuyenBao v11.32 — ẨN trang admin: mở mogul.huyenbao.com vẫn là bảng điều khiển nhưng URL không đổi, đường dẫn thật chuyển sang /adm, /admin cũ chết (404)
summary: HIDDEN ADMIN. The game-management console moved from /admin to the unlisted /adm route. On the dedicated mogul.huyenbao.com domain the root URL now serves the console via a silent Next.js proxy rewrite — the address bar stays on the root, so visitors cannot see where the console lives. The old /admin path was deleted entirely and returns 404 on every host. /adm remains reachable directly, the full game stays at /game on the mogul domain, and every /api/admin/* endpoint is still protected by the fail-closed ADMIN_KEY guard — the hidden path is obscurity, the key is the real lock. Any other host (huyenbao.com, localhost, LAN IP) is unaffected: the game stays at /. Deploy configs and the VPS guide were updated; Caddy/nginx need no changes as long as they pass the Host header through.
features: Admin route moved /admin → /adm (git mv, zero code changes inside the console)
mogul.huyenbao.com/ silently rewrites to /adm — URL bar never reveals the real path
Old /admin returns 404 on all hosts — no stray links left behind
/game escape hatch unchanged; /api/* untouched and still ADMIN_KEY-guarded
deploy/ README URL map + Caddy/nginx annotations updated for /adm
Version bumped to v11.32 at FRONT of app name
